# Craft Beer School

> Craft Beer School is an India-based beer school teaching brewing, tasting, branding and the business of beer, online and in person. Based in Bengaluru, serving learners across India and worldwide.

## Courses

- [Brewing Fundamentals](https://craftbeerschool.in/courses.html): The science of brewing, ingredients, equipment, technique. Online sessions plus your first real recipe. Duration 4 Weeks. Price INR 5999.
- [Advanced Brewing Science](https://craftbeerschool.in/courses.html): Go deeper into chemistry, microbiology and advanced fermentation for serious brewers and pros. Duration 6 Weeks. Price INR 12999.
- [Brewery Business Management](https://craftbeerschool.in/courses.html): The business behind the brew, plan, launch and grow a brewery, from finance to distribution. Duration 3 Weeks. Price INR 8999.
- [Style Specialization](https://craftbeerschool.in/courses.html): Master IPAs, stouts, lagers, sours and Belgian ales, history, technique and award-winning versions. Duration 8 Weeks. Price INR 18999.
- [Beer Branding and Packaging](https://craftbeerschool.in/courses.html): Build a beer brand that stands out and packaging that sells, for aspiring brewers and founders. Duration 3 Weeks. Price INR 4999.
- [Sensory Evaluation](https://craftbeerschool.in/courses.html): Train your palate like a pro, taste, identify off-flavours and score beer with real sensory methods. Duration 2 Weeks. Price INR 5999.

## Key pages

- [Courses](https://craftbeerschool.in/courses.html): all six online courses and in-person workshops.
- [Resources](https://craftbeerschool.in/resources.html): free Beer 101, styles primer, glossary and brewing calculators.
- [FAQ](https://craftbeerschool.in/faq.html): experience needed, format, class size, certification, payment and refunds.
- [About](https://craftbeerschool.in/about.html): mentors, mission and teaching method.
- [Contact](https://craftbeerschool.in/contact.html): enrolment form, phone and WhatsApp.

## Facts

- Format: live online sessions plus hands-on in-person brewery workshops.
- Certification support: WSET and Cicerone preparation.
- Cohorts are deliberately small, with one-to-one mentorship.
- Contact: chatty@cheerschattyventures.com, +91-98209-25347.
